hooks.command: INPUT=$(cat); if [ "$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_input.subagent_type // empty')" = "Explore" ]; then SID=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r '.session_id // empty'); PROJ="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}"; if [ -f "$PROJ/docs/patterns.md" ]; then if [ ! -f "/tmp/claude-patterns-$SID" ]; then echo 'BLOCKED — Read docs/patterns.md first (it documents the codebase map and conventions). Only launch Explore if patterns.md does not cover your need; this block clears once patterns.md has been read this session.' >&2; exit 2; fi; else echo 'No docs/patterns.md found. After exploration, create one with the codebase map.'; fi; fi

INPUT=$(cat); FP=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$FP" in */docs/patterns.md) SID=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r '.session_id // empty'); touch "/tmp/claude-patterns-$SID" ;; esac

if [ -f .claude/session-handoff.md ]; then echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"SessionStart","additionalContext":"A session handoff file exists at .claude/session-handoff.md from a previous session. Invoke the session-resume skill to read it and present it to the user."}}'; fi
